text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National commission in charge of follow-up of social accord signed in August last year will meet on Feb 12-13.
- Office Cherifien des Phosphates to help create 10,000 jobs in central city of Khouribga.
- Casablanca Finance Group director-general Adil Douiri says need to reform administration and the judiciary to curb corruption which deters foreigners from investing in Morocco.

- Union leader Noubir Amaoui rebukes Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj for saying pay increases will endanger budget balance. Rises had been decided last August within the accord signed between unions, businesses and authorities.
